ios.desc:
See the total nutrition of your meals—displayed in the familiar Nutrition Facts label format you find on food packaging.

Add the fruits and vegetables in your morning smoothie to see its complete Nutrition Facts. Enter the ingredients of your favorite recipes to know exactly what nutrients are in them. Use Nutrition Calc to discover if you're getting adequate vitamins and minerals daily.

Features:
• Up to 150 different nutrients for each food
• See combined totals for all foods in your list
• Adjust serving size in grams, ounces, or pounds
• Specify portion size for each food item
• Save your food lists and recipes for later use
• Tap any nutrient row to highlight it for easy tracking
• Local and cloud search powered by the USDA database
• Adjustable font size, remembered across app restarts
• Progress saved between sessions
• Add recipes as a single item for convenient tracking
• Profile settings for gender and age

Know what's in your food before you eat it.
